papers.title: TTPO: Test-Time Policy Optimization
papers.what: Removes the ground-truth label from reasoning post-training by splitting a majority-vote rollout group asymmetrically, distilling agreeing rollouts and penalising disagreeing ones with grouped reinforcement learning, so that the update survives a wrong vote and matches label-supervised on-policy self-distillation on five competition benchmarks while raising Qwen3-1.7B from 38.0 to 45.2 percent.
papers.builds_on: TTT Layers (Sun 2024, JEGI4IS7); TTT for Abstract Reasoning (Akyurek 2024, W7RPRTCH); DeepSeek-R1 (2025, Z5IWHZAE)

papers.title: The Impact of Temporal Context Length and Encoding Strategies on Self-Supervised ECG Representation Learning
papers.what: Holds the Transformer backbone and training protocol fixed while varying only the ECG input horizon and the front end, and finds that 5- to 10-minute contexts transfer and retrieve better than the standard 16-second window, and that continuous patch embeddings beat vector-quantised tokens at every horizon.
papers.builds_on: PatchTST (Nie 2023, YY67LF3R); MAE Theory (Zhang 2023, 6INGKIJV); HeAR (Baur 2024, 3LA8GNCU); Chronos (Ansari 2024, 72DFULQQ)

papers.title: PAWBench: How Far Are We from Probabilistically Aligned World Modeling?
papers.what: Formalises probabilistic alignment as the requirement that a video world model reproduce the distribution of valid outcomes rather than one plausible trajectory, and finds across 50 scenarios and eleven systems that none matches the reference probabilities while still covering the range of valid behaviours.
papers.builds_on: DDPM (Ho 2020, GX7WR7KA); DiT (Peebles 2023, YJ9TK993); World Model Evaluation (Vafa 2024, P92FLHJ2)

papers.title: Understanding Evolution Strategies for LLM Reasoning: Broader Reasoning Coverage than GRPO
papers.what: Shows that evolution strategies raise Pass@1 while also raising Pass@K where GRPO collapses entropy, ties the gain to verifier-projected population diversity, and finds the parameter movement is functionally sparse and does not cause forgetting.
papers.builds_on: DeepSeek-R1 (2025, Z5IWHZAE); PPO (Schulman 2017, KQTIJC4U); Latent-GRPO (Deng 2026, U4ZPM5DN)
